comment: The manual says the six CV inputs override the parameter controls; the code adds them to the knob and then clamps (src/sn-vcox.cpp:297-308), which is what the lines describe. As on sn-vco, the rotation CV input is configured with the name ±5V Φ while the knob it feeds is θ. The phase parameter has no widget on this panel and is left untagged. The attenuator is configured with the name ɡ while the panel prints ATT, and the summed output is configured as VCO-Σ, which is what the panel prints too. The summed output has no range given because it is a running total with no clamp on it.
